documents.title: User stories — Action registry (S04)
documents.body:
# User stories — Action registry (S04)

## Personas

- **The action author (S05–S11)** — declares an operation once; adds actions, never a surface.
- **The client developer (S12–S14, the SPA)** — reads `GET /api/actions` and calls `POST /api/actions/<name>/invocations`; must not need a second contract.
- **The MCP consumer (the agent behind the gateway)** — gets the same operations as MCP tools at `/mcp`.
- **The platform operator** — runs `serve` and `worker`, migrates, and needs a bad registry to die before bind.
- **The integration owner** — ingests a service's `openapi.json` and approves a breaking change as a version.
- **The tenancy and security reviewer** — proves the MCP surface is scope-filtered, a refused tool is absent, and a bad bearer fails closed.
- **The auditor** — reads `action_invocation` and `audit_event` and must be able to tell what committed from what rolled back.
- **The S00 parity owner** — carries the `parity_ids` trace this slice cannot close.

## Stories

- As an action author, I want one `#[action]` declaration to emit the spec, the manifest entry, the OpenAPI operation, the MCP tool and the literal route, so that four projections cannot drift.
- As a client developer, I want `GET /api/actions` under an ETag, so that I cache the manifest and detect change in one conditional request.
- As a client developer, I want every action invocable at one route with one error shape, so that I write one client and one error path.
- As an MCP consumer, I want the same actions as tools whose `structuredContent` equals the HTTP body, so that the channel I pick does not change the result.
- As an MCP consumer with a narrow role, I want a tool I may not call to be absent from `tools/list`, so that the surface is closed rather than noisy.
- As the platform operator, I want a duplicate name, an MCP collision or an out-of-charset name to exit 1 before bind, so that a bad binary never serves traffic.
- As the integration owner, I want a breaking upstream change refused until I approve a version, so that an imported action cannot silently change shape under a caller.
- As the auditor, I want the mutation, the invocation row and the audit row in one transaction, and a timeout in its own, so that the record cannot claim work that rolled back.
- As a caller, I want one idempotency key to replay the winner's status and body, so that a retry cannot double-write.
- As the S00 parity owner, I want the plan's `parity_ids` discharged in `parity/parity.yaml`, so that the slice's operations are traced in the parity contract.

## Scenarios

```gherkin
@verify=S04.1
Scenario: every registered action returns the same body over HTTP and MCP
  Given the compiled registry and a dev-seeded tenant
  When each action is invoked once over POST /api/actions/<name>/invocations and once over tools/call at /mcp
  Then with request_id and duration_ms stripped, the HTTP body equals the MCP structuredContent
  And the gate's twenty actions (sixteen internal and four fixtures.*) are all covered

@verify=S04.2
Scenario: one value projects three identical hashes
  Given one ActionSpec
  When its manifest entry, its reference-resolved OpenAPI operation and its MCP tool are hashed
  Then all three spec_hash values are identical
  And every action in the registry satisfies the same equality

@verify=S04.3
Scenario: a duplicate, a collision or a bad MCP name exits before bind
  Given a binary whose registry holds a second copy of members.set_role
  When serve starts with CONVEYOR_TEST_DUPLICATE=members.set_role
  Then the process exits 1 before the listener binds
  And an MCP-form collision (cards.move against cards_move), an MCP name outside the 1-64 lowercase digit underscore charset, a handler-less internal action and an unknown scope fail the same assertion

@verify=S04.4
Scenario: two identical posts with one key replay and write once
  Given a tenant and an action that mutates
  When two identical requests carry the same Idempotency-Key
  Then both receive the same status and body, the loser replaying the winner
  And exactly one action_invocation row and one mutation row exist

@verify=S04.5
Scenario: schema-invalid input is a refusal, never a 500
  Given members.set_role with its required fields missing
  When it is invoked over HTTP with a stale If-Match
  Then the response is RFC 9457 with a type and populated errors
  And the status is a 4xx, never 500

@verify=S04.6
Scenario: the lock catches drift and a breaking ingest is refused
  Given the committed served-spec.lock.json
  When an operation is renamed, added or removed and --check-lock runs
  Then it exits 1 and names the operation
  And the removed-field ingest fixture exits 2 with 422 while the approved spec version keeps serving

@verify=S04.7
Scenario: a slow external action times out, rolls back and records itself
  Given fixtures.slow with timeout_ms 200 pinned at ingest
  When it is invoked and the stub sleeps 600 ms
  Then the invocation transaction rolls back
  And a separate short transaction writes action_invocation with outcome timeout and audit_event with status error

@verify=S04.8
Scenario: a tool the role cannot call is absent and refused
  Given a role without a tool's scope
  When tools/list is read and the same action is called over HTTP
  Then the tool is absent from tools/list and the HTTP call is refused
  And an unresolvable tenant is 401, and a JWT-shaped bearer that fails verification is never retried as a licence token

@verify=S04.9
Scenario: the four external fixtures behave exactly as the plan states
  Given the four fixture operations ingested from the test openapi.json
  When fixtures.echo, fixtures.fail and fixtures.timeout are invoked
  Then echo answers 200 with the same body over both channels
  And a requested 4xx is action-external-refused, a 504 is 502 action-upstream-failed, and five failures in 30 s answer 503 action-circuit-open with no upstream call
```

## Verify

- `@verify=S04.1` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test parity_http_mcp every_registered_action_returns_the_same_body_over_http_and_mcp`
- `@verify=S04.2` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test registry one_value_projects_three_identical_hashes`
- `@verify=S04.3` — `! CONVEYOR_TEST_DUPLICATE=members.set_role cargo run -p conveyor-server -- serve` (exit 1); `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test duplicate`
- `@verify=S04.4` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test idempotency one_key_two_posts_replay_and_write_one_invocation_and_one_row`
- `@verify=S04.5` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test registry schema_invalid_input_is_rfc_9457_with_populated_errors_and_never_a_500`; the plan section 7 curl against members.set_role
- `@verify=S04.6` — `cargo run -p conveyor-server -- --print-openapi --check-lock`; `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test ingest_diff a_removed_field_is_breaking_while_the_approved_version_keeps_serving`
- `@verify=S04.7` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test timeout a_slow_action_times_out_rolls_back_and_records_a_timeout_row`
- `@verify=S04.8` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test parity_http_mcp a_tool_the_role_cannot_call_is_absent_from_tools_list_and_refused_over_http`
- `@verify=S04.9` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test external_actions the_external_fixtures_behave_exactly_as_the_plan_states`

## Links

- Plan: `docs/plans/slices/S04-action-registry.md` sections 5.1-5.4, 7, 9.
- Spec: `docs/SPEC.md` section 5.5, section 7, section 8 S4, section 3 D11.
- Issue: #3, `S04 — the external action execution contract (import to invoke to restart)`.

## Notes

Reconstructed on 2026-11-28 for standard v4 from the S04 plan and the built tree. The plan frontmatter names `issues #13`, and its own section 7 delivery note records the correction from the stale `planned`; the live unit is #3, labelled `S04`, closed by PR #766 — the plan's own section 7 delivery note records the same correction. The scenarios are the plan section 7 properties (a) to (f) plus timeout, MCP fail-closed and the external fixtures.

documents.body:
# Acceptance criteria — Action registry (S04)

## Scenarios

- `@verify=S04.1` — every registered action returns the same body over HTTP and MCP once request_id and duration_ms are stripped; the gate's twenty (sixteen internal, four fixtures) are covered.
- `@verify=S04.2` — one spec_hash per action equals the manifest entry, the reference-resolved operation and the MCP tool.
- `@verify=S04.3` — a duplicate name, an MCP-form collision, an out-of-charset MCP name, a handler-less internal action or an unknown scope exits 1 before bind.
- `@verify=S04.4` — two identical posts with one Idempotency-Key return one status and body and write one invocation row and one mutation row.
- `@verify=S04.5` — schema-invalid input returns RFC 9457 with a type and populated errors, never 500.
- `@verify=S04.6` — a renamed, added or removed operation makes `--check-lock` exit 1 and name it; the removed-field ingest exits 2 with 422 while the approved spec version serves.
- `@verify=S04.7` — fixtures.slow at timeout_ms 200 rolls its transaction back and is recorded in a separate transaction as outcome timeout and audit status error.
- `@verify=S04.8` — a scope-refused tool is absent from `tools/list` and refused over HTTP; an unresolvable tenant is 401; a failing JWT-shaped bearer is not retried as a licence token.
- `@verify=S04.9` — the four external fixtures behave as declared: echo 200, requested 4xx is action-external-refused, 504 is 502 action-upstream-failed, five failures in 30 s open the breaker with 503 action-circuit-open.

## Verify commands

- `@verify=S04.1` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test parity_http_mcp every_registered_action_returns_the_same_body_over_http_and_mcp`
- `@verify=S04.2` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test registry one_value_projects_three_identical_hashes`
- `@verify=S04.3` — `! CONVEYOR_TEST_DUPLICATE=members.set_role cargo run -p conveyor-server -- serve` (exit 1); `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test duplicate`
- `@verify=S04.4` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test idempotency one_key_two_posts_replay_and_write_one_invocation_and_one_row`
- `@verify=S04.5` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test registry schema_invalid_input_is_rfc_9457_with_populated_errors_and_never_a_500`
- `@verify=S04.6` — `cargo run -p conveyor-server -- --print-openapi --check-lock`; `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test ingest_diff a_removed_field_is_breaking_while_the_approved_version_keeps_serving`
- `@verify=S04.7` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test timeout a_slow_action_times_out_rolls_back_and_records_a_timeout_row`
- `@verify=S04.8` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test parity_http_mcp a_tool_the_role_cannot_call_is_absent_from_tools_list_and_refused_over_http`
- `@verify=S04.9` — `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test external_actions the_external_fixtures_behave_exactly_as_the_plan_states`

## Results

Measured in this worktree on 2026-11-28: `crates/actions/tests/` carries the six files the plan names plus `duplicate.rs`; the manifest page `docs/design/data/actions.json` lists 635 action names, all dotted, with the four `fixtures.*` present; `served-spec.lock.json` holds 666 operations; `crates/actions/src/invoke.rs` carries the per-action circuit breaker, the `kind: workflow` 501 and the statement_timeout plus tokio timeout composition; `crates/actions/src/registry.rs` reads `CONVEYOR_TEST_DUPLICATE`. The plan's 2026-11-22 delivery evidence recorded the gate green at 527 actions; the manifest has since grown to 635 because later slices added actions to the same registry — the surface did not change. No gate command was re-run while composing this document, so this section records the artefacts' measured contents, not a fresh pass claim.

## Status

built and closed — the plan records `status: built 2026-11-22` with its section 7 gate evidence; issue #3 is CLOSED and PR #766 (`issue/3-s04-runtime-resolution`, one resolution model for compiled and imported external actions) merged 2026-11-26 as `6d21598`. Open items, recorded honestly: `parity_ids` stays `PENDING-S0` because `parity/parity.yaml` does not yet name these actions — an S00 trace obligation, not an S04 deliverable; the three section 10 questions remain open as recorded defaults (role-filtered manifest; 30 s compiled against 10 s at ingest; generated TS client as CI artefact with the lock committed); and the closed #3 still carries the `status:claimed` label.

## Links

- Plan: `docs/plans/slices/S04-action-registry.md` sections 5, 7, 9, 10.
- Issue: #3; PR: #766; merge commit `6d21598`.

documents.title: Definition of ready — Action registry (S04)
documents.body:
# Definition of ready — Action registry (S04)

## Independent

S04's files are disjoint from its neighbours: `crates/actions-derive/` (a new tenth workspace member), `crates/actions/src/{spec,registry,invoke,mcp,openapi,lock,ingest}.rs`, six test files, `crates/api/src/actions.rs`, `crates/store/src/actions.rs`, `migrations/0003_action_registry.sql` and `served-spec.lock.json`. It declares no domain action (`cards.move` and the rest are S05-S11's), no `kind: workflow` engine (S13), no channel-`mcp` delivery row and no signed `mcp_server` channel (S06). It edits no S02 table and no S03 aggregate; its only ordering constraint is the typed dependency on S02 and S03.

## Negotiable

The outcome is fixed by SPEC section 8 S4 — twenty actions identical over HTTP and MCP — while the implementation was settled by the seven decisions the plan closes: `crates/actions-derive` is a tenth member (S4-D1); one literal route per action plus a `spec_exempt` fallback (S4-D2); enable/disable is `approved_at` (S4-D3); an external name colliding with any name is refused at ingest (S4-D4); the idempotency scope is the action name (S4-D5); MCP tools are scope-filtered and a refused tool is absent (S4-D6); `kind: workflow` answers 501 until S13 (S4-D7). Three questions carry defaults (section 10): a role-filtered manifest, 30 s compiled against 10 s at ingest, and the generated TS client as a CI artefact with the lock committed.

## Valuable

It removes the named gap: before S04 there was no registry, so HTTP, MCP, the manifest and OpenAPI were four declarations to keep in step. It replaces the 24 node packages and fr's 88 capability declarations with one `ActionSpec` per operation, and every later slice adds actions to that one surface rather than a new one. The measure is the gate itself: twenty actions identical over HTTP and MCP, one `spec_hash` across three projections.

## Estimable

The starting state is measured: S02 shipped `begin_scoped`, `audit_event`, `action_invocation`, `idempotency_key`, `event` and `/api/me`; S03 shipped the fourteen aggregates; `crates/actions` was empty. The plan pins its sources with revisions (`agent` `83b8de7e`, `fr` `4a579e91`, source map `6f7c5097`) and gives a twelve-step build order, each step with the command that proves it.

## Small

One proc-macro crate, one actions crate, one migration (`0003_action_registry.sql`), one manifest route, one MCP endpoint, sixteen internal actions and four fixtures, six test files and one lock file. The four external fixtures exist because the timeout, refusal and breaker paths need a controllable upstream — not as a second feature.

## Testable

Every property carries an executable proof: the parity test compares bodies across both channels; `spec_hash` equality is asserted for every spec; the boot assertion is exercised by `CONVEYOR_TEST_DUPLICATE`; the RFC 9457 refusal, the idempotent replay, the timeout rollback, the lock drift and the ingest diff each have a named test. All nine acceptance scenarios name their command, and the plan section 7 gate block is the project-level test.

## Dependencies

- blocked-by: S02 — `begin_scoped`, `audit_event`, `action_invocation`, `idempotency_key`, `event`; S03 — the fourteen domain aggregates the internal actions read and write.
- blocks: S05-S11 (domain actions declared on this registry), S06 (channel-`mcp` delivery rows and the signed `mcp_server` channel), S13 (`kind: workflow` behind the 501).
- related: S00 — `parity/parity.yaml` and `parity/native.tsv` must name these operations; `parity_ids` is `PENDING-S0` and remains S00's trace obligation.

## Notes

Reconstructed for standard v4 on 2026-11-28 from the S04 plan and the built tree. The live unit is #3, labelled `S04`; the plan frontmatter's `issues #13` is stale, and the plan's own section 7 delivery note records the `planned` → built correction.

# Definition of done — Action registry (S04)

## Acceptance criteria

| Scenario | Evidence | Verify |
|---|---|---|
| S04.1 HTTP and MCP return the same body | `crates/actions/tests/parity_http_mcp.rs`, `every_registered_action_returns_the_same_body_over_http_and_mcp` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test parity_http_mcp every_registered_action_returns_the_same_body_over_http_and_mcp` |
| S04.2 one value, three identical hashes | `ActionSpec::spec_hash`; `crates/actions/tests/registry.rs`, `one_value_projects_three_identical_hashes` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test registry one_value_projects_three_identical_hashes` |
| S04.3 duplicates and collisions exit before bind | `crates/actions/src/registry.rs` (the `CONVEYOR_TEST_DUPLICATE` injection and the six checks); `crates/actions/tests/duplicate.rs` | `! CONVEYOR_TEST_DUPLICATE=members.set_role cargo run -p conveyor-server -- serve`; `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test duplicate` |
| S04.4 idempotent replay writes once | `crates/actions/tests/idempotency.rs`, `one_key_two_posts_replay_and_write_one_invocation_and_one_row` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test idempotency one_key_two_posts_replay_and_write_one_invocation_and_one_row` |
| S04.5 schema-invalid input is RFC 9457, never 500 | `crates/actions/tests/registry.rs`, `schema_invalid_input_is_rfc_9457_with_populated_errors_and_never_a_500`; the plan section 7 curl | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test registry schema_invalid_input_is_rfc_9457_with_populated_errors_and_never_a_500` |
| S04.6 the lock catches drift; breaking ingest refused | `served-spec.lock.json` (666 operations, measured); `crates/actions/tests/ingest_diff.rs`, `a_removed_field_is_breaking_while_the_approved_version_keeps_serving` | `cargo run -p conveyor-server -- --print-openapi --check-lock`; `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test ingest_diff a_removed_field_is_breaking_while_the_approved_version_keeps_serving` |
| S04.7 timeout rolls back and records itself | `crates/actions/tests/timeout.rs`, `a_slow_action_times_out_rolls_back_and_records_a_timeout_row`; `fixtures.slow` with timeout_ms 200 | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test timeout a_slow_action_times_out_rolls_back_and_records_a_timeout_row` |
| S04.8 a refused tool is absent and refused | `crates/actions/tests/parity_http_mcp.rs`, `a_tool_the_role_cannot_call_is_absent_from_tools_list_and_refused_over_http`; `the_manifest_is_role_filtered_and_answers_304_on_a_matching_etag` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test parity_http_mcp a_tool_the_role_cannot_call_is_absent_from_tools_list_and_refused_over_http` |
| S04.9 the external fixtures behave as declared | `crates/actions/tests/external_actions.rs`, `the_external_fixtures_behave_exactly_as_the_plan_states`; breaker and 501 in `crates/actions/src/invoke.rs` | `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test external_actions the_external_fixtures_behave_exactly_as_the_plan_states` |

## Evidence at completion

Measured in this worktree on 2026-11-28: `crates/actions/tests/` carries the plan's six files plus `duplicate.rs`; the manifest page `docs/design/data/actions.json` lists 635 action names, all dotted, with the four `fixtures.*` among them; `served-spec.lock.json` holds 666 operations; the circuit breaker (`action-circuit-open`), the `kind: workflow` 501 and the statement_timeout plus tokio timeout composition are in `crates/actions/src/invoke.rs`. The plan's 2026-11-22 delivery evidence recorded the section 7 gate green at 527 actions; the manifest grew to 635 through later slices adding actions, not surfaces. Issue #3 is CLOSED and PR #766 merged 2026-11-26 as `6d21598`. No gate command was re-run while composing this document, so the Evidence column names the proof's location and the measured counts; the pass verdict is the plan section 7 gate's last recorded run.

## Repo gate

The unit's gate is the plan section 7 block: `cargo test -p conveyor-actions`; `cargo run -p conveyor-server -- --print-openapi --check-lock` exiting 0; the duplicate boot refusal exiting 1 before bind; and the RFC 9457 curl against members.set_role. Those invocations are historical: on this estate no local compiling build runs — the compile and test verdict is the repository's GitHub-hosted preflight and the PR's CI, and the only local gate is the non-compiling one. For these four Delivery documents the gate is the standard's: `python3 scripts/check-output-standard.py` and the design build's check under campaign #930.

## Merge and closure

One issue, one branch, one PR: #3 `S04 — the external action execution contract`, branch `issue/3-s04-runtime-resolution`, PR #766 merged 2026-11-26. The plan is the build record and its section 7 carries the gate evidence. These four Delivery documents are authored on `issue/930-standards-batch-1` and close with the #930 campaign's single PR; they add no code, open no S04 PR and claim no new test run. Left open and named, not waived: `parity_ids` `PENDING-S0` (S00's trace obligation), the three section 10 questions as recorded defaults, and the stale `status:claimed` label on closed #3.

## Links

- Plan: `docs/plans/slices/S04-action-registry.md` sections 5, 7, 9, 10.
- Record: `crates/actions/`, `crates/actions-derive/`, `migrations/0003_action_registry.sql`, `served-spec.lock.json`, `docs/design/data/actions.json`.
- Issue #3; PR #766; merge commit `6d21598`.
